name: clearchoice
description: A transparent, user-controlled layer for clearer choices in existing interfaces.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run extension:build && playwright test tests/e2e/*.spec.js
scripts.check: node --check packages/engine/src/index.js && node --check packages/engine/src/browser-adapter.js && node --check services/ai-gateway/src/server.js && node --check apps/browser-extension/src/content.js && node --check apps/browser-extension/src/background.js && node --check apps/browser-extension/src/popup.js
scripts.build: npm run extension:build && npm run check
